source.notes: Documentation describes Infuse-Direct, Infuse-Library, and Infuse-Download connection types and example Emby/Jellyfin headers. Infuse is closed source; no ordered request flow has been verified.

headers.X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser Token="${access_token}", Client="${connection_type}", Version="${version}", Device="${device_name}", DeviceId="${device_id}"

authorization.format: Documented MediaBrowser token header; exact sign-in and token acquisition sequence requires owner capture.
